selection_rationale: The limited second Seed was selected after all eleven new Seed0 positions and the complete eight-configuration comparison were sealed. K-20-S tests the main certificate benefit: stock certifies in 101.63538490096107 seconds while matched GI-TBC remains open at its 1200-second cap. R-B35-S-T2 tests the largest observed U regression: stock U rises by 0.05655759224710244 and the signed gap worsens from 0.12565667598847344 to 0.172018618174727 despite a higher L. K35 and RX35-T2 opposed endpoints remain in the primary table; they are not replaced or discarded. This is conditional finite confirmation, not a new independent sample or a runtime-distribution estimate. Both methods start fresh, pay their full own H and other costs, use Gurobi Seed1 with H seed20260626, and retain the original physical parameters and caps. Before any Seed1 Optimize, actual native coefficient readback exposed a tiny-slope LP-reader transport defect. All primary scopes were natively bridged and unaffected. STOCK Seed1 therefore uses the separately registered V2 exact power-of-two transport build; this is disclosed as a build confirmation as well as a limited second Seed, not a pure Seed-only change. The original unused registration/gate is retained under repair/seed1_pre_coefficient_fix.
